title: Operating point and design limits of the hybrid distributed-Raman + EDFA span example (80 km G.652 fiber, C-band)
model: First-order linear-programming design (hybrid.design_lp, layer L3) checked with the full multi-wavelength counter-pumped Raman boundary-value model (hybrid.raman_full, layer L2); EDFA represented by the average-inversion relation with card EDFA-PERIN2019

device.type: span design example (not a hardware device)
device.host: G.652 transmission fiber (card RAMAN-G652) followed by the Er-doped fiber of ref. [124] (card EDFA-PERIN2019)

reference_plane: plane A = input of the transmission fiber; plane B = EDFA output. Span net gain G_net = G_on-off,Raman - alpha_s L_span - L_passive + G_EDFA (net gain as defined in ITU-T G.665, 01/2005 edition, clause 4.3)
notes: Fiber attenuation (alpha_s, alpha_p) and the Raman gain efficiency C_R are taken from card RAMAN-G652; the EDF length, alpha(lambda), g*(lambda), zeta and alpha_p(980 nm) from card EDFA-PERIN2019. The spectral shape of the Raman gain efficiency is the SSMF profile distributed with GNPy (data/raman_ssmf_gnpy.csv); entry raman_scaling states how it is scaled. Entries of category 'assumed' are design choices of this example and must not be read as measured properties.

L_span.applies_to: length of the counter-pumped transmission fiber

L_passive.applies_to: wavelength-independent lumped loss between plane A and plane B other than the transmission fiber: pump-signal WDM coupler, EDFA isolators and couplers, insertion loss of a gain-flattening filter (the spectral shape of a real GFF is not modeled)

verification.note: illustrative value; not taken from a component data sheet

G_target.applies_to: mean span net gain over the channel plan (transparent span); enforced as an equality constraint

n_ch.applies_to: number of signal channels, equally spaced in frequency between lam_ch_min and lam_ch_max (end points included)

lam_ch_min.applies_to: shortest channel wavelength; design band restricted to the C-band because no open L-band EDF card with provenance is available

P_ch_in.applies_to: launch power per channel at plane A (40 x 0 dBm = 16.0 dBm total)

lam_pump_grid.applies_to: candidate wavelengths of the counter-propagating Raman pumps launched at the span end; the LP chooses their powers (zero allowed)

source.basis: single fiber-Bragg-grating-stabilized 14xx nm Raman pump modules are specified at up to 600 mW (1420-1470 nm) and 550 mW (1471-1495 nm) (Lumentum S35 series product page, read 17 Nov 2026); 0.4 W launched per wavelength leaves margin for pump-combiner and WDM-coupler insertion loss

P_pump_max.applies_to: maximum pump power per wavelength launched into the transmission fiber

verification.note: the basis was checked against the vendor page; the value itself is a design assumption

source.basis: double Rayleigh scattering (DRB) crosstalk grows steeply with the distributed gain (entry r_rayleigh, hybrid.drb_crosstalk); the cap is a design choice, not a sourced threshold. The 6-7 dB of manuscript l.121 is a sensitivity improvement, not an on-off gain, and is not used here

G_onoff_cap.applies_to: upper limit of the first-order Raman on-off gain of every channel

verification.note: sensitivity to the cap reported with the design

nbar_min.applies_to: lower bound of the length-averaged upper-level population of the EDF when it is an LP variable

nbar_max.applies_to: upper bound of the length-averaged upper-level population of the EDF when it is an LP variable; the 980 nm pump power needed to hold the chosen value is estimated with hybrid.edfa_pump_980

source.ref: Corning product information sheets of G.652 fibers (SMF-28e+ PI1463; SMF-28 Ultra 200 PI1450) as summarized by a web search on 17 Nov 2026; the sheets themselves could not be opened

B_rayleigh_1ns.applies_to: Rayleigh backscatter coefficient at 1550 nm for a 1 ns pulse; used only for the DRB estimate

verification.note: UNVERIFIED: confirm in the data sheet of the fiber actually used

r_rayleigh.derivation: r_R = 10^(B_R/10) / (c tau / (2 n_g)) with tau = 1 ns and group index n_g = 1.468 (assumed)
r_rayleigh.applies_to: Rayleigh backscatter capture coefficient per unit length used in the double-scattering integral of hybrid.drb_crosstalk

verification.note: inherits the UNVERIFIED status of B_rayleigh_1ns

raman_scaling.value: C_R(df; f_p) = C_R[RAMAN-G652] * (f_p / f_card) * g0(df) / max(g0); f_card = c / 1450 nm

source.basis: spectral shape g0(df) from the SSMF profile distributed with GNPy (reference pump 1454 nm, reference effective area 75.75 um^2); absolute level from the derived card value C_R = 0.406 1/(W km) at 1450 nm (A_eff = 80 um^2, K = 2); linear scaling with pump frequency as for g_R in card RAMAN-G652

raman_scaling.applies_to: Raman gain efficiency between any two waves (pump-signal, pump-pump, signal-signal) for 1420-1565 nm; the wavelength dependence of A_eff is neglected

verification.consistency: peak efficiency 3.5 % below the GNPy profile at the same pump frequency; the alternative scalings g0 * (75.75/80) and g_R,GNPy / 80 um^2 give -1.9 % and +2.8 % relative to the chosen level (hybrid.cr_scaling_check)
